title.rendered: IIT-Bombay Research Internship – 2025 [Eligibility, Shortlisted Candidates, Stipend Rs. 15k Month] Apply by 8 Sep

content.rendered:
Are you aspiring to gain hands-on research experience at one of India’s top-ranked institutes? The IIT-Bombay Research Internship 2025 is now open for applications. This competitive opportunity allows selected students from across India to work with IIT Bombay faculty members, engage in cutting-edge research, and enhance their academic and career prospects.

With a monthly stipend of Rs. 15,000, expert mentorship, and exposure to groundbreaking projects, this internship is one of the most sought-after research experiences in the country. If you are interested, make sure to submit your application on or before 8th September 2025.

In this article, we cover all key details about eligibility, selection process, stipend, important dates, shortlisted candidates list, and application procedure.

About IIT Bombay Research Internship 2025

The Research Internship at IIT Bombay is designed to nurture young minds from universities and colleges (other than IIT Bombay) by giving them a platform to work on high-impact research projects. These internships are available across various departments such as:

  • Computer Science and Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Chemical Engineering
  • Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics
  • Humanities and Social Sciences
  • Biosciences & Bioengineering
  • Interdisciplinary Domains

Selected interns will work under faculty-led research projects that can potentially lead to publications, presentations, and outstanding learning outcomes.

Key Highlights

  • Institution: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay)
  • Internship Name: IIT Bombay Research Internship 2025
  • Monthly Stipend: Rs. 15,000
  • Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra
  • Eligibility: Pre-final year UG/PG students from recognized universities (excluding IIT Bombay students)
  • Internship Duration: Typically 4–6 months
  • Mode: On-campus internship (at IIT Bombay)
  • Last Date to Apply: 8 September 2025

Eligibility Criteria

To apply for the IIT Bombay Research Internship 2025, students must satisfy the following eligibility conditions:

Educational Qualification

  • Pre-final year undergraduate (B.Tech/B.E.) students or equivalent.
  • Postgraduate students (M.Sc., M.Tech., Integrated M.Sc./M.Tech.) are also eligible.
  • Applicants must not be IIT Bombay students, as this program is specifically designed for external students.

Academic Performance

  • CGPA of 7.5/10 (or equivalent percentage 75%) and above in your current degree program.

Other Requirements

  • Strong academic and research orientation.
  • Willingness to work on full-time, on-campus internship.
  • Good communication and technical skills in the chosen subject area.

Duration of Internship

The standard internship duration is 4 to 6 months, depending on the project requirements. Interns are expected to commit full-time at IIT Bombay during this period.

Stipend Details for IIT-Bombay Research Internship

One of the biggest advantages of this internship is the financial support provided by IIT Bombay.

  • Monthly Stipend: ₹15,000
  • Mode of Payment: Disbursed directly to the intern during the internship period.
  • The stipend helps cover living costs in Mumbai, making it easier for students to focus fully on their research work.

Selection Procedure

The selection process for the IIT Bombay Research Internship is highly competitive:

  1. Online Application Submission – Eligible students must submit their application along with academic transcripts, resume, Statement of Purpose (SOP), and preferred research area.
  2. Screening of Applications – Faculty members at IIT Bombay review the applications based on grades, research interest, and academic background.
  3. Shortlisting of Candidates – After initial screening, a list of shortlisted students will be announced on the IIT Bombay internship portal.
  4. Interviews / Additional Evaluation (if required) – Some faculty may conduct interviews or written evaluations.
  5. Final Selection – Selected candidates will receive official confirmation and joining instructions.

Shortlisted Candidates List

The shortlisted candidates list will be announced by IIT Bombay in the second week of September 2025.

  • Students will be able to check their names directly on IIT Bombay’s official internship portal.
  • Selected interns will also receive an official email confirmation along with project details.

Pro Tip: Keep checking your registered email ID and IIT Bombay’s internship webpage regularly after the application deadline.

Benefits of IIT Bombay Research Internship

Participating in this program comes with multiple academic and professional advantages:

  • Research Experience at a Premier Institute – Gain exposure to India’s top-notch labs and expert faculty.
  • Strong Academic Profile – An IIT Bombay internship strengthens your CV for higher studies, PhD applications, and jobs.
  • Networking Opportunities – Connect with IIT professors and fellow researchers.
  • Skill Development – Learn advanced research methodologies, scientific writing, and project execution.
  • Stipend Support – Financial assistance ensures affordability during the internship tenure.
  • Possibility of Publications – Outstanding work may result in research papers or conference presentations.

Important Dates for IIT-Bombay Research Internship

Here’s a quick timeline of the IIT Bombay Research Internship 2025:

  • Application Start Date: August 2025
  • Deadline to Apply: 8 September 2025
  • Shortlisted Candidates List: Mid-September 2025
  • Internship Start Date: October/November 2025 (tentatively)

Application Process

Follow these steps to apply for the internship:

  1. Visit the official IIT Bombay Research Internship portal.
  2. Register with your personal and academic details.
  3. Upload the required documents:
    • Resume/CV
    • Academic transcripts/grade sheets
    • Statement of Purpose (SOP)
    • Recommendation letter (if required by project/faculty)
  4. Select your preferred research area and faculty member (optional).
  5. Submit the application before 8th September 2025.

Make sure your SOP reflects your genuine research interest and motivation to work at IIT Bombay.

Conclusion

The IIT Bombay Research Internship 2025 is a golden opportunity for students who want to explore advanced research, gain mentorship from top professors, and add a world-class internship to their profile. With a stipend of ₹15,000 per month, this program also provides financial support while enhancing your academic and career trajectory.

If you meet the eligibility requirements, don’t miss this chance. Apply before 8 September 2025 to secure your spot in this highly competitive internship.
